meaning: INVENTED EXAMPLE of qualification/JOBS.json as the job runner reads it: the case ids are invented. Only listed cases not marked nonattempt can be prepared; a case marked nonattempt is frozen at once with the nonattempt subcommand, with its reason (an upper-case code; NONATTEMPT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE when none is given); the qualification admission pins this file under the label JOBS.json.
